brands.name: Formula Energy
brands.location_label: Tweed Heads South, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Gold Coast / Tweed Heads custom surfboards founded in 2008 by shaper Eden Scallan at 48 Machinery Drive, South Tweed Heads.

models.name: Nice Mid-Up Twin
models.description: Performance Mid Length. The most refined performance Step Up inspired Mid Length to date, if foam is your friend but you still want to bank a few turns in the critical part of the wave then read on! Surf in the pocket and rip it up on this performance Mid Length Twin Fin. Similar to the MLB idea (Catch more waves) but way more refined, more rocker, less rail and a thin tail and nose. Its sits closer to a step up than a mid length. But carries a wider point forward that gives it the versatility to ride from grovel waves to pumping surf, hence its sits in the the MIDDLE of the quiver, as an alternate to normal Gun or big board just blown up to float you.

models.name: Best One Yet
models.description: Performance twin fin made for good waves. Incredibly user friendly shape, slight extra width up front, allows you to ghost into serious waves with ease. Whether it cruising into weaker waves with a bit more length or paddling into serious juice this is a versatile model, which fits right next to a Mid Length in the quiver. Really lights up when waves start pumping!

models.name: Lil Beak
models.description: Genuine performance twin fin. Made for good waves, speed generation and turning tight in the pocket.With a Beak nose for a little extra foam up front, slightly fuller nose outline. Pronounced hip into a small swallow tail. This board is all about good waves and performance to see where you can take your surfing. Order same size as your performance everyday go to "Thruster" surfboard.

models.name: Mid Length Beak
models.description: User Friendly performance Mid Length. Old school Beak nose, with plenty of foam under chest, fuller rails up front,with foiled out tail. Ultimate fun machine whilst designed to paddle well, glide into waves and turn in the pocket. Whether you want it for marginal waves or good surf this model will compliment your quiver.

models.name: RP Twin
models.description: Performance Twin designed to ridden slightly shorter than your normal modern shortboard. Designed to be surfed rail to rail with plenty of speed and flow and used with upright style twins.

models.name: Fresh Fish
models.description: Based of the Old school fish design, flatter deck line, plenty of wide and foam. 12 inch tail pod with 6 inch deep swallow tail.

models.name: Nemo
models.description: Super popular, fun board with a performance edge. Glides over fat sections with ease and generates unbelievable speed. Fuller nose planshape allows you to get greedy and out paddle anyone in the line up. Tight tail pod removes all that unwanted drift you get in traditional Fishes.

models.name: Mutant
models.description: Small wave fun machine for marginal wave quality,high performance fish outline with performance based attributes. Fuller nose with wider point forward for paddle power and single flyers into a swallow tail.

models.name: Alien
models.description: The most popular board we have created so far. A must add to your quiver. If you only could travel with ONE board around the world, this would be the it! High performance fish, with wide point forward, for easy paddling, but with a tight performance based tail-pod for performance based surfing in the pocket.

models.name: Spiral
models.description: Small Wave Hybrid, unique set up with single flyers diamond tail shape. Flat Deck line, plenty of foam especially in the rails. Read Here for full breakdown.

models.name: Mid Strength
models.description: Beak in the nose,with plenty of foam under chest, fuller rails,with foiled out tail. Ultimate fun machine whilst designed to paddle well,glide into waves and turn in the pocket. Whether you want it for marginal waves or perfect little peelers, this model will compliment your quiver.

models.name: MLT Twin
models.description: Mid Length Twin Fin,designed as an alternate option for a vast variety of waves. Get into waves fast and early and bring back a bit of old school "steeze" into your surfing. Read the full review here.

models.name: Option
models.description: Small Wave Micro Mal, for small, average waves that lack power. Super fun and user friendly as twin fin or add a little style and ride as a single fin, either way a small compact alternative when you need the glide of longboard bur want to fit it in the pocket!

models.name: Performance Plus
models.description: This model is our traditional performance plan-shape, step-up semi-gun model. Custom built to your specific requirements designed for good quality waves. Indonesia bound or pumping days back home.

models.name: Little Thing
models.description: Based on the Fish style model nose up front but with a conventional squash tail, Rails bottom curves all enhanced for the twin fin experience. More surface area in the tail pod, adding stability and forgiveness from your rail to rail transitions. Small wave speed machine with Fish Like qualities.

models.name: Alien Step-Up
models.description: Lots of guys of late have been expressing the conundrum of enjoying riding there ALIEN so much in all kinds of surf that when they return to a ”longer” board when the waves get ”solid”… The enjoyment factor is not there and they struggle with the traditional plan-shapes,and basically have a shocker of a surf as adjusting between short and longer boards can be frustrating.We imported the ALIEN high performance fish, ”feeling” into a step up board for the more solid days. Something that will hold, paddle well and still fit in the pocket.. In simple go longer, marginally narrower in width and lessen the thickness. What you have is the USC ALIEN STEP UP…For the longer winter swells or Indo sojourn.. For example if your USC ALIEN is 5’10 by 19 3/4 by 2 3/8 ( 28.08 litres) then you could step up to a 6’2 by 19 1/2 by 2 5/16 (29.01 litres).

models.name: Hi-Performance
models.description: For good to excellent wave conditions. Will go in marginal to ok conditions but designed to come alive and push your surfing when in good waves. Cleaner deck lines, improved rocker, more forgiving rails and overall a much better, way improved surfboard, all designed for easier rail to rail transitions, and noted quickness coming back out of turns. With instant speed (single to double concave bottom) from combining a far more accurately made board.

models.name: Blend
models.description: As the name suggests a nice mix of performance /all rounder with a little twist! Modern performance outline with a pronounced hip in the tail allowing for quick release through turns. Pivot and release with amazing ‘”pop”"out of your turns. Order approximately 2 to 3 inches shorter than your normal performance go-to board.

models.name: Convert
models.description: Small wave speed machine with fish like qualities but performs like a modern short-board with double flyers reducing tail area and acting as a break point for jamming tighter arcs. Leading into a forgiving squash tail.

models.name: Savage
models.description: PRO–SURFER BRENT SAVAGE,signature all round performance modern short board. Designed to work on and above the lip. Now available after much research, development and refining by Brent in our patented USC Range, No hesitation, no holding back, this board is designed for average to good waves and made to be pushed as hard as you can with constant speed,flow and tail release for performance based surfing with the extra benefit of the parabolic carbon rails for extra speed and drive through the most responsive flex pattern available.

models.name: Must
models.description: Sits just under your Hi Performance board. A Modern performance outline hides flatter entry rocker allowing instant speed but little extra tail kick with a Round Tail which is incredible versatile from beach breaks to reef passes. This board is a "Must" in the Quiver, great travel board when you not sure whether it going to be pumping or dribble!

models.name: Have
models.description: Inspired by the Single Fin Era. Designed with wide point up front. Giving plenty of paddle power and an incredible versatility in many type of waves. Essentially made for bigger surf, longer paddles and people who enjoy "heavy water", and look forward to bigger waves. Video Review Click here.

models.name: Adapt
models.description: Small wave speed machine with fish like qualities with width and foam up front and plenty of area in the tail pod, but performs like a modern short-board, quick release with plenty of speed and flow. Leading into a forgiving squash tail.

models.name: Sin Twin
models.description: Classic Twin outline with Single flyers,diamond tail shape and with the added benefit of rear stabiliser or "Two Plus One" set up.

models.name: Demon
models.description: The DEMON is a fun style of board with a performance based edge. The fuller nose plan-shape hides a deceptively easy board to throw around and jam hard in the pocket but still with plenty of foam up front to glide over dead sections with ease.
